added: A square dance's formation now offers Square, which a new square dance starts on, Circle for a big-circle dance such as a running set, and Other for anything else, instead of the contra formations. Changing a dance's type to square starts it on Square unless its formation is Circle or Other.
Add squareFormationShapes; offeredFormationShapes gives square dances square, circle and other (ADR-007 §8.1).
